metadata.description: Hen Cohen's shared Claude Code skills, one plugin per skill so each project enables only what it uses.

plugins.name: ui-lab
plugins.description: UX/UI suggestions as tappable mocks in an app's UI lab: mock, close the round, promote.

plugins.name: android-emulator
plugins.description: Start and stop a project's Android emulator, pick the phone or emulator, install, open and screenshot the app.

plugins.name: qnn-npu-compile
plugins.description: Compile ONNX models for Qualcomm NPUs (QNN HTP) and run them on Android with sherpa-onnx or ONNX Runtime.
